assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent painted CRED stat badge for an ornate Loteria fantasy trading card. Input image is the edit target. The round head is a BLANK number field, so no eyes, mouth, nose, numbers or marks inside the blue circle. Its round silhouette and floating halo should supply the angel cue. Remove BOTH hanging red-and-gold prize ribbon tails completely. Remove the polygonal/octagonal facets around the head and replace them with a smooth round gold edge. Preserve the attached red horizontal label extension on the RIGHT, its gold outline, its existing shape, and the exact cream lettering 'CRED', with no extra decoration. Keep the head centered vertically with the CRED label extension; halo above. No wings on this version, no heart, no laurel, no rosette, no other ornaments. Match the original hand-painted style, warm luminous gold, deep blue enamel and red label background, strong dark brown contours, subtle illustrative texture. Compact and legible at 160 pixels overall width. Closely fit the transparent canvas to the complete silhouette including the halo, with about 3% clear margins, no clipped edges. Genuinely transparent background, preserve alpha. Only one complete badge, front-facing, no perspective or shadows outside its silhouette.
